newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecommunications sees Q4 revs up.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecommunications sees Q4 revs up.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said on Wednesday it estimated revenues in the fourth quarter ended October 31 rose to $254 million from $174 million a year ago.
Estimated revenue from companies acquired during 1996 was $32 million during this fourth fiscal quarter of 1996, the telecommunications systems company said.
For the year ended October 31, estimated revenue was $827 million, up from $586 million a year ago, the company said.

About $68 million of revenues from companies acquired during 1996 are included in the estimated total for the year, the company said, adding that final fourth quarter and annual results for 1996 will be announced during the second week of December.
ADC shares closed up 3/16 at 36-3/4 on Nasdaq Wednesday.
